data.name: Touch of Acid
data.description: As a standard action, you can perform a melee touch attack that deals 1d6+%1 points of acid damage. You can use this ability %2 times per day. At 11th level, any weapon that you wield deals +1d6 points of acid damage, similar to how a flaming weapon operates.|OracleTouchofAcidDamageBonus|OracleTouchofAcidTimes
